name: FA_CATEGORY_BOOK_DEFAULTS
description: FA_CATEGORY_BOOK_DEFAULTS contains the default depreciation rules that used for asset addition. A row is inserted into this table for each asset category, depreciation book, and date placed in service range for which you set up the category.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset category.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: START_DPIS
columns.description: Starting date placed in service to which this set of default depreciation rules applies.

columns.name: END_DPIS
columns.description: Ending date placed in service to which this default depreciation rule applies.

columns.name: DEPRECIATE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the assets assigned to the category depreciate by default.

columns.name: METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation method.

columns.name: FLAT_RATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rates for the flat rate depreciation method.

columns.name: SPECIAL_DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Default depreciation limit amount for the category in the book.

columns.name: CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the prorate convention.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the prorate convention.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation bonus rule.

columns.name: CEILING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation ceiling.

columns.name: PERCENT_SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Default salvage value percentage for the assets added to this category.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_TYPE
columns.description: Default depreciation limit type assigned to the category. It can be either amount, percentage, or none.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT
columns.description: Depreciation limit percentage for the asset.

columns.name: USE_STL_RETIREMENTS_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether straight line depreciation method should be used for retirement transaction.

columns.name: STL_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the straight line depreciation method used to calculate the depreciation for retirement transaction.

columns.name: SUBCOMPONENT_LIFE_RULE
columns.description: Rule by which the life is defaulted to the component assets added to this category.

columns.name: MINIMUM_LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Minimum life for the component assets.

columns.name: CAPITAL_GAIN_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Minimum time to hold an asset for Oracle Fusion Assets to report it as a capital gain on the form 4797 reports when you retire it.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identification number of the group asset.

columns.name: MASS_PROPERTY_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the category is mass property is eligible or not.

columns.name: RECOGNIZE_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Option indicating whether gain or loss to be recognized for member asset retirement.

columns.name: RECAPTURE_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether reserve for the group asset can exceed its recoverable cost.

columns.name: LIMIT_PROCEEDS_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the member asset proceed of sale should be limited to its recoverable cost.

columns.name: TERMINAL_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Option indicating how terminal gain or loss to be recognized for member asset retirement.

columns.name: TRACKING_METHOD
columns.description: Option indicating the group asset tracking method that is used to calculate group and its member asset depreciation.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FULLY_RSV_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether fully reserved assets depreciable basis should be excluded from the group asset's depreciable basis or not.

columns.name: EXCESS_ALLOCATION_OPTION
columns.description: Option indicating whether excess depreciation of the group asset is to be allocated to its member assets or reduced from the group asset depreciation.

columns.name: DEPRECIATION_OPTION
columns.description: Option indicating whether the member asset's depreciation expense is calculated using its group asset depreciation rules or the member asset depreciation rules.

columns.name: MEMBER_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether group asset depreciation is sum of member asset depreciation or calculated separately.

columns.name: ALLOCATE_TO_FULLY_RSV_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether group asset depreciation amount should be allocated to fully retired assets.

columns.name: ALLOCATE_TO_FULLY_RET_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether group asset depreciation amount should be allocated to fully retired assets.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
